segments.name: precision metal parts
segments.description: Manufactures and sells precision fasteners, structural parts and other precision metal parts for new energy vehicle and intelligent electronic equipment customers.
segments.evidence: As a result of the assessment made by CODM, the Company has only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers and original equipment manufacturers in consumer electronics, new energy vehicles and other fields buy precision metal parts through a direct sales model.
revenueModel.evidence: We use a direct sales model and the sales department is responsible for customer contact, product sales, after-sales services and customer maintenance.
